6-Month (180 Days) Development Capacity Validation

The total project development effort of 1,969.3 hours aligns precisely with the resource capacity of the team over the 180-day (6-month) calendar timeline:

  • 6 Months Calendar duration = 180 days, which translates to exactly 128.5 working days (excluding weekends).
  • At 8 working hours per day, a 1.0 FTE resource has a maximum capacity of 1,028 hours over 6 months.

Project risk assessment parameters aligned with Section 9 of the Client BRD. Risk ratings directly determine the project contingency buffer applied to the base development cost.

Risk Score Calculation Basis & Methodology
  • Individual Risk Score Formula: Risk Score = Likelihood (1-5) × Impact (1-5). Individual scores range from 1 (Very Low) to 25 (Critical).
  • Total Project Risk Score: Sum of scores across all active BRD risk categories (Current score: 56 / 150).
  • Contingency Buffer Formula: Contingency Buffer % = (Total Risk Score / 100) × 30%.
  • Current Contingency Buffer: At a risk score of 56, the applied contingency buffer is 16.8% (17%), added directly to base labor cost to insulate against third-party CPO delays and OCPI telemetry integration risks.
